answer: Accuracy-indexed bonds resist sybils: each identity posts refundable collateral returned only in proportion to how well its later grades track eventual consensus, so a nebula of fakes voting to inflate their own cluster drifts off-consensus and forfeits bond per head. An honest grader emits real signal and recovers fully; a hollow identity casting self-serving votes leaks collateral every epoch. Running N fakes means N full bonds, each eroding as it misaligns — the fraud itself burns the capital, so depth cannot be faked cheaply.
